observation_only.message: Intelligent Climate is observation-only and cannot change HVAC equipment.

no_zones_configured.title: Intelligent Climate has no configured zones
no_zones_configured.description: The equipment group remains safely loaded but has no climate zone to observe. Add a zone from the Intelligent Climate integration entry, or remove the equipment-group entry if it is no longer needed. Continue using the original thermostat for physical HVAC control.

missing_entity.title: Intelligent Climate entity is missing
missing_entity.description: One or more configured thermostats or enabled observation sources no longer exist in Home Assistant. Open the Intelligent Climate integration entry and reconfigure the affected zone to replace or remove the missing references. Continue using the original thermostat for physical HVAC control.

incompatible_entity.title: Intelligent Climate entity is incompatible
incompatible_entity.description: One or more existing observation sources no longer match their configured temperature or humidity binding. Inspect the Intelligent Climate entry and reconfigure the affected zone with a compatible source. Continue using the original thermostat for physical HVAC control.

migration_failed.title: Intelligent Climate persisted data could not be validated
migration_failed.description: Intelligent Climate could not safely migrate or validate persisted configuration or runtime data. Invalid configuration does not start; unsafe runtime data is ignored while live observation reconciles when possible. Inspect the integration entry, storage health, and logs before reloading. The original thermostat remains available for physical HVAC control.

store_write_failed.title: Intelligent Climate runtime data could not be saved
store_write_failed.description: Intelligent Climate encountered at least three consecutive failures while saving nonauthoritative runtime data. Inspect Home Assistant storage health and logs. In-memory observation can continue, and the original thermostat remains available for physical HVAC control.

command_boundary_violation.title: Intelligent Climate blocked an unexpected control attempt
command_boundary_violation.description: Intelligent Climate received an unexpected physical-command intent and suppressed it. No physical equipment was commanded. Disable the Intelligent Climate integration and report this defect before using it again; continue controlling equipment through the original thermostat.

user.title: Create equipment group
user.description: Define the physical HVAC equipment group to observe. Thermostat selection follows before the entry is created.

data_description.equipment_group_name: A recognizable name for this HVAC system.
data_description.equipment_type: The type of heating and cooling equipment in this group.

thermostats.title: Select thermostats
thermostats.description: Select every existing climate entity owned by this equipment group.

data_description.thermostat_entity_ids: One or more existing Home Assistant climate entities that are not owned by another Intelligent Climate entry.

relationship.title: Describe the thermostat relationship
relationship.description: Multiple thermostats must be explicitly modeled as independent systems in one group or shared/zoned equipment.

first_zone.title: Create the first zone
first_zone.description: The parent equipment group is not created until this first complete zone is valid.

data_description.zone_name: A recognizable display name for this climate zone.
data_description.zone_thermostat_entity_ids: During initial setup, assign every selected thermostat to the first zone. Membership can be redistributed through parent reconfiguration after more zones are added.
data_description.temperature_sources: Existing climate entities or temperature sensor entities.

confirm.title: Confirm observation-only setup
confirm.description: Create {equipment_group} with {thermostat_count} thermostat(s), relationship {relationship}, and first zone {zone}. Intelligent Climate remains observation-only and will not change HVAC equipment.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure equipment group
reconfigure.description: Change equipment metadata, thermostat ownership, or the relationship without changing the stable equipment-group identity.

reconfigure_zone.title: Assign thermostats to {zone}
reconfigure_zone.description: Choose the parent thermostats that serve this zone. Every parent thermostat must remain assigned to at least one zone.

abort.invalid_existing_configuration: Stored Intelligent Climate configuration is malformed and cannot be updated safely.

init.title: Observation options
init.description: Change observation, aggregation, source-health, and bounded-history behavior. These options never control physical HVAC equipment.

error.invalid_options: The submitted observation options are inconsistent or outside the supported bounds.

user.title: Add zone
user.description: Create a named climate zone using the equipment group's thermostat and one or more temperature sources.

data_description.zone_name: A recognizable display name for this climate zone.
data_description.zone_thermostat_entity_ids: One or more thermostats from the parent equipment group.
data_description.temperature_sources: Existing climate entities or sensor entities with the temperature device class.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure zone
reconfigure.description: Change the zone display name or temperature sources without changing stable zone or retained source identities.

data_description.zone_name: The new display name for this climate zone.
data_description.zone_thermostat_entity_ids: One or more thermostats from the parent equipment group.
data_description.temperature_sources: Existing climate entities or sensor entities with the temperature device class.

source.description: Set calibration and aggregation metadata for {source}. Values are stored with the stable source identity.
